review.notes: Full review. All five r10 findings repaired. Two new P3: solomonTits docstring and README 3.2 claim nonemptiness at m=2 that the stated degree-k isomorphisms do not give (the empty simplicial set satisfies them); 2.4 restricts Dedekind even injectivity to n>=4 although the same paragraph uses K2 of finite fields at n=3 and K-book p. 409 gives n=2. Gate rerun OK; depcheck 238 roadmaps, 2322 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean gives 4 sorry warnings only; #check of 6 declarations keeps all binders; one-tactic probes close nothing. Seeded sample (1.3, 2.1, 3.2, 3.4, 4.2, 4.4, 5.1, 5.3, 6.3, 6.5, 6.6, 6.12, 6.15, 8.2, 8.8) checked against kbook, kahn, putman-studenmund, borel1974/1977, caputo, wildkernel, banaszak, hutchinson, thomason (Prop 1.36, Cor 1.48, Thm 2.45) and groenewegen; SchemeKTheoryOperations 4.3 verified at #1229. Source issues: two errors in kbook V.6.8.2, Caputo Ex. 2 misprint, plus the VI.8.1 and VI.2.1.2 errata.
